players.product: Enhanced geothermal (EGS) 24/7 baseload power from modular GeoBlocks (Cape Station geocluster, Utah) under long-term PPAs with hyperscalers, utilities and industrial buyers, grid-connected and behind-the-meter

quarterly_data.quarter: Fervo Energy press release: Fervo Energy Secures Two U.S. Department of Energy Awards (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fervo's release on two U.S. Department of Energy awards for new EGS developments in Idaho and Nevada: in Idaho, Fervo will drill and complete EGS wells in Elmore County in partnership with multiple national labs and deploy and test new technology for high-temperature EGS operations; in Nevada, it will run a targeted appraisal campaign at a high-priority EGS prospect in Humboldt County to confirm the reservoir is suitable for EGS development. The release states Project Red, its EGS commercial pilot, has been generating 3 MW of gross power to the Nevada grid since 2023. CTO Jack Norbeck: 'We expect this funding to accelerate Fervo's pipeline and advance the cutting edge of geothermal technologies.'
quarterly_data.figure: EGS wells in Elmore County, Idaho; appraisal campaign in Humboldt County, Nevada; Project Red 3 MW gross since 2023
